match_note: Communications Materials file (previously reviewed at another journal). The round-1 reports describe the v1 content: title, Fig. 3 sonograms b-f with white fitted peak-position lines, Fig. 4 analysis at t = 9 ps, relative FM thickness D_FM, five nucleation scenarios I-V, ~30 nm in-plane diameter via qz broadening, columnar domains and a broad-applicability claim in the abstract. Minor layout differences (reviewer refers to Fig. 4 panels a-c) cannot be checked exactly.

concerns.quote: The term' Sonography' is used but without any introduction/justification on why the techniques can be named such.
concerns.summary: The name 'X-ray sonography' is not justified or distinguished from ordinary time-resolved XRD of laser-induced strain.

concerns.quote: the designation of FM and AFM peaks are never clearly stated/identified in the manuscript... I do not think the AFM signal, with the superstructure to appear at (1/2 1/2 ) is even detected
concerns.summary: How the two Bragg peaks are assigned to the FM and AFM phases is not stated, and the referee doubts an AFM signal is measured at all.

concerns.quote: all the interpretation of the observed strain induced peak position shift/oscillation was attributed to heterogeneous AFM/FM domains even all speculated from models without experimental support.
concerns.summary: The domain-heterogeneity conclusion rests on modelling of peak shifts rather than direct evidence; R2 asks that the indirect, model-dependent nature be stated explicitly.

concerns.quote: the manuscript does not explicitly state how it is determined
concerns.summary: The source of the ~5 nm/ps strain-pulse velocity (literature, calibration or fit) is not stated.

concerns.quote: a clearer explanation of how thermal expansion and phase transition induced volume changes are incorporated into the elastic simulations
concerns.summary: How thermal expansion and the transition volume change enter the elastic model, giving strain not centred on zero, needs clearer explanation.

concerns.quote: the interpretation of the white guide lines across panels b–f is difficult to follow
concerns.summary: Fig. 3 does not make clear how the guide lines are obtained and why their differences encode phase geometry.

concerns.quote: Figure 4 plays a central role in the quantitative conclusions but is not self explanatory.
concerns.summary: Fig. 4 (fixed 9 ps view, curves, colour scales, panel logic, model curves) is hard to read.

concerns.quote: its geometrical interpretation within each scenario is not fully transparent
concerns.summary: How the relative FM thickness D_FM(t) maps onto the phase geometry of each nucleation scenario is unclear.

concerns.quote: the absence of explicitly documented control measurements ruling out probe induced or instrumental effects currently limits the robustness of the interpretation.
concerns.summary: Controls excluding probe-induced or instrumental qz shifts should be documented in the Supplementary.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

concerns.quote: The abstract claims broad applicability, but the paper never explicitly states where the technique works and where it does not.
concerns.summary: Conclusions and abstract overstate generality and model independence; the practical requirements and scope of the method should be stated.

concerns.quote: the estimation of the in plane domain size is not required for the main conclusions and could arguably be better placed as Supplementary Discussion
concerns.summary: The in-plane domain size estimate should move to the Supplementary to avoid overemphasising it.

concerns.quote: The analysis assumes a single sound velocity for both AFM and FM phases. But the sound velocity in AFM and FM phase of FeRh are actually different.
concerns.summary: Using one sound velocity for both phases needs justification and an assessment of its impact.

concerns.quote: the ~30 nm in-plane diameter is inferred through a multi-step argument ... At a minimum, the authors should state explicitly the error bar of such estimation.
concerns.summary: The 30 nm lateral size and the domain height lack error bars and a description of uncertainty propagation.

concerns.quote: The columnar domain seems to be assumed rather than justified.
concerns.summary: The columnar domain shape is assumed; can the data discriminate between domain shapes?

later_concerns.quote: Now the confusing assignment of FM and AFM reflections is cleared. But still needs clear and precise description.
later_concerns.summary: Describe the peaks as structural Bragg reflections of the domains hosting each phase.

later_concerns.quote: how the emergent FM domain crystal structure was identified is not described
later_concerns.summary: Explain how the emerging second Bragg peak is identified as the FM phase.

later_concerns.quote: better be also supported by other works by citing relevant references reporting on the emergence of FM domain randomly with laser excitation.
later_concerns.summary: Cite work on random FM domain emergence to support the inhomogeneous-nucleation picture.

later_concerns.quote: Still not fully satisfied with the title saying the sonography.
later_concerns.summary: Suggests a more modest title than 'sonography' (optional).

later_concerns.quote: The strain profile in Fig. 1 is not correct, as the strain wave at the interface will have reflected wave also
later_concerns.summary: The conceptual strain profiles in Fig. 1 ignore interface reflections.
